verdict.rationale: Manufact documents connecting hosted MCP servers to editors and MCP clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude), plus its own MCP server for platform management. Nothing in the evidence describes documented adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. Editor and MCP-client connection is an adjacent capability and does not count as framework/SDK adapters.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
